name: Davco Superfine White Grout
paste:
DAVCO® SUPERFINE WHITE GROUT: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Davco® Superfine White Grout, December 2025, Version 01.01 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/5/davco-superfine-whitegrout.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Davco® Superfine White Grout where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (December 2025, Version 01.01).
1.2 Product description. Davco® Superfine White Grout is an bright white, unsanded, Sanitized®, smooth finish cement based grout resistant to a broad spectrum of moulds and bacteria. Davco® Superfine White Grout is suitable for wall applications internally for joints from 1 - 3mm.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer.
    - Davco® Superfine White Grout is suitable for most types of tiles and natural stone.
    - Davco® Superfine White Grout is suitable for both commercial and domestic wall applications including shower, bathroom and laundry walls where a bright white wall grout is required.
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.8.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Davco® Superfine White Grout
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: A BRIGHT WHITE SMOOTH FINISH CEMENT BASED GROUT
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals, certificates and standards stated by the manufacturer. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (December 2025, Version 01.01) has no approvals, certificates or standards section.
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - AS ISO 13007.3: cited with a stated property or value. Where: Product Information > Product Declaration (p.1).
    - SCAQMD method 304-91: cited with a stated property or value. Where: Product Information > Volatile organic compound (VOC) content (p.1).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Bright white appearance
    - Suitable for wall applications only
    - Sanitized®
    - Mould & bacteria resistant
    - Smooth finish
    - For joints 1 - 3mm
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Product Declaration: AS ISO 13007.3 CG1
    - Bulk Density: 1.3kg/L
    - Volatile organic compound (VOC) content: Low VOC - 3g/L (SCAQMD method 304-91)
2.6 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: 1.5kg, & 5kg Plastic film bags; 10kg, & 20kg Paper bags
    - Shelf life: Plastic film bags: if unopened grout shall remain usable for up to 18 months from date of manufacture. Paper bags: if unopened grout shall remain usable for up to 12 months from date of manufacture.
    - Storage conditions: Store grout in an elevated location, in dry cool conditions out of direct sunlight.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 General. Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (December 2025, Version 01.01) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.
3.2 Surface preparation.
    - Before commencing grouting, ensure the tile adhesive has set firmly. This usually requires 24 hours with the majority of tile adhesives depend on application conditions.
    - Remove any spacer lugs, rake-out any excess adhesive and any loose or foreign material from the grout joints.
    - In general, ensure the grout joints are clean and dry.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (December 2025, Version 01.01) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Mixing Ratio: 5.5 - 6 Litres per 20kg bag
    - Pot Life: 40 Minutes at 23°C and 50% RH.
    - Curing Time: 24 hours at 23°C & 50% RH.
4.3 Consumption. Quantity of grout required kg/m²
    | Tile Size | 1.5mm Joint | 3mm Joint |
    | 10x50x6mm | 0.8kg | 1.6kg |
    | 150x150x6mm | 0.3kg | 0.6kg |
    | 200x100x6mm | 0.3kg | 0.6kg |
    | 200x200x6mm | 0.2kg | 0.4kg |
    | 300x600x9mm | 0.13kg | 0.25kg |
    The coverage of the grout will vary depending upon the texture, size and thickness of the tile and the width of the grout joint. Use the table as a general guide only.
4.4 Equipment. Tools required;
    - Mixing buckets & clean water
    - Drill with mixing paddle
    - Grout float / rubber squeegee
    - Sponge & dry cloth
    - Personal protective equipment
4.5 Mixing. 1. The mixing ratio is 20kg of powder to 5.5-6L of potable water. 2. Add the water to a bucket, then slowly add the Davco Sanitized® Superfine White Grout powder to the water. Stir the mix until a lump-free toothpaste consistency is achieved. 3. Allow the mix to stand for 5 minutes, re-stir, then use the grout.
    - Note: Where movement is expected, or for superior performance in general applications, use Davco 4 in 1 Grout Additive instead of water alone. Refer to the Davco 4 in 1 additive data sheet for additional information.
4.6 Application. 1. Prior to grouting it is advisable to lightly dampen the grout joints, particularly with porous tiles or in hot conditions. 2. Using a rubber float or squeegee, work the grout into the joints in a diagonal motion. Make sure the grout is worked into the joint (it should not bridge the joint). 3. Using a diagonal motion remove excess grout from the surface of the tiles with a rubber float or squeegee. 4. Clean up the remainder of the grout with a lightly dampened sponge. Regularly rinse the sponge out to help with cleaning and don’t make it too wet. 5. Leave the grout to cure for 24 hours before cleaning the haze off with a dry cloth.
4.7 Cleaning of tools. Tools and surrounding areas should be cleaned up with water while grout is still soft and wet
4.8 Limitations and important considerations.
    - Test the product in an inconspicuous area first.
    - Not suitable for use in harsh and demanding environments or other areas where there are hygiene regulations and chemical resistance requirements. A Sika® epoxy grout should be used for these applications.
    - Cleaning or discolouration problems may occur when used with textured, porous or natural stone tiles
    - Do not use on floors
    - Do not use on submerged applications including pools, ponds, spas or water features
    - Do not use in movement joints.
    - Product may be weakened or damaged when exposed to neat or strong acids.
    - Product may not be suitable for stone sensitive to moisture, test prior to installation for compatibility.
    - For other uses not mentioned in these instruction please contact https://aus.sika.com/

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions stated in the limitations. Also stated in the data sheet limitations (clause 4.8):
    - Product may not be suitable for stone sensitive to moisture, test prior to installation for compatibility.
5.3 Trials, test areas and compatibility checks stated by the manufacturer.
    - Test the product in an inconspicuous area first.
    - Product may not be suitable for stone sensitive to moisture, test prior to installation for compatibility.
5.4 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.5 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Davco® Superfine White Grout, December 2025, Version 01.01, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/5/davco-superfine-whitegrout.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Davco Superfine White Grout, version 18/06/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/0/sds-davco-superfinewhitegrout.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety related data.
6.3 Maintenance - Cleaning. Davco® Superfine White Grout shall require routine maintenance and cleaning with a neutral detergent and water.
6.4 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.5 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.6 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
